zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空以波音737 MAX 8開闢安克拉治—東京航線、2027年5月起每日營運
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空宣布2027年夏季自安克拉治推出四條新航線，其中安克拉治—東京成田航線將以波音737 MAX 8執飛，2027年5月13日至9月7日每日營運。
body: 阿拉斯加航空宣布為2027年夏季，自安克拉治泰德史蒂文斯國際機場推出四條新航線，其中直飛東京成田的航線仍須取得政府核准。東京航線預定2027年5月13日至9月7日每日營運，停航三個月後於2028年1月起每週三班恢復營運；阿拉斯加至日本的跨太平洋飛行時間約8小時15分鐘，並將跨越國際換日線。
其餘三條季節性航線分別前往奧斯汀、達拉斯—沃斯堡與納許維爾。東京航線將以波音737 MAX 8執飛，報導指出這將是美國與日本之間唯一以單走道飛機營運的服務，也是多年來阿拉斯加與日本之間的首條直飛定期服務。該公司737 MAX 8有159座與161座兩種三艙等配置。
報導回顧，安克拉治過去曾是日本與美國本土及歐洲航班的中途停留點，但1990年代後重要性大幅下降，原因包括西伯利亞空域開放與航程更長的飛機使中途停留不再必要；該空域於2022年再度關閉。阿拉斯加航空另以波音787-9每日營運西雅圖—塔科馬至東京成田航線，並將於2027年5月14日以夏威夷航空提供的空中巴士A330開闢大阪關西航線。

en.title: Alaska Airlines to link Anchorage and Tokyo with Boeing 737 MAX 8, daily from May 2027
en.summary: Alaska Airlines will launch four new routes from Anchorage for summer 2027, including a Tokyo-Narita service operated by the Boeing 737 MAX 8, daily from May 13 to September 7, 2027.
body: Alaska Airlines has announced four new routes from Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport for the summer 2027 season, including a direct service to Tokyo-Narita that remains subject to government approval. The Tokyo service is scheduled to operate daily from May 13 to September 7, 2027, and to resume in January 2028 with three flights a week after a three-month suspension. The transpacific flight from Alaska to Japan takes about 8 hours and 15 minutes and crosses the International Date Line.

The other three seasonal routes link Anchorage with Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth and Nashville. The Tokyo service will be operated by a Boeing 737 MAX 8, which the report describes as the only single-aisle service between the United States and Japan and the first scheduled nonstop service between Alaska and Japan in many years. Alaska's 737 MAX 8 fleet has two three-class configurations, with 159 and 161 seats.

Anchorage was once a stopover point for flights linking Japan with the U.S. mainland and Europe, but its importance declined sharply in the 1990s as Siberian airspace opened to Western airlines and longer-range aircraft made an Alaskan stop unnecessary; that airspace closed again in 2022. Alaska also operates a daily Boeing 787-9 service from Seattle-Tacoma to Tokyo-Narita, and will begin an Osaka-Kansai service on May 14, 2027, using an Airbus A330 provided by its subsidiary Hawaiian Airlines.
